Here's a very unique registered cultivar created by Travis Wyman and grown out/selected by Rob Co of the pitcher plant project! It's Reptilian Rose x flava var. rubricorpora x leucophylla! It was registered very recently, here's a link to the description: cpn.carnivorousplants.org/articles/CPNv51n2p109_123.pdf

I've been eyeballing and trying to acquire this clone for so many years, but was always told that it wasn't available until almost 2 ago, I got a super tiny division! It has since tripled in size, but is still very small LOL Pics taken 7/12/23:









Here are some photos of Crown of Thorns growing in Rob Co's greenhouse back in 2015!







Here's the reason it's called Crown of Thorns! it seems as though you need just the right environmental conditions to get it to "thorn up." I don't quite know what those conditions are just yet, as my plant is still pretty small:
